title: Rollers rule
description: A 1px charcoal hairline of a ruled page grid that draws itself in as it scrolls into view: horizontal lines grow from the left edge, vertical ones grow down from the top. CSS view timeline.
notes: absolutely positioned: give the parent `relative` and place it with className (inset-x-0 top-0, inset-y-0 left-1/2…)
a horizontal line finishes a third of the way up the window, so one in the last 300px of a page stops short: use a plain border there
